questions.question: What is the key advantage of HSL (Hue, Saturation, Lightness) over Hex/RGB color formats?
options: It is much more intuitive for humans to adjust tints, shades, and complementary colors
questions.hint: Hue, saturation, and lightness are natural to manipulate.
questions.explanation: HSL allows developers to easily create darker, lighter, or saturated variations by adjusting a single percentage number.

questions.question: Which background-size value scales an image to completely fill the box while preserving aspect ratio, cropping if necessary?
questions.explanation: background-size: cover scales the image to completely cover the container, clipping overflow edges to preserve aspect ratio.

questions.question: How do you create a background that is 50% transparent black without making the text inside it transparent?
questions.hint: Use alpha channel on the background color.
questions.explanation: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) applies transparency exclusively to the background color, keeping child elements and text fully opaque.

questions.question: Which modern color function provides perceptually uniform color distribution across modern wide-gamut (P3) displays?
questions.hint: oklch is the modern perceptual standard.
questions.explanation: oklch() is a modern perceptual color format supported in all modern browsers that accesses vibrant wide-gamut P3 colors.

questions.question: In a linear-gradient, how do you set a diagonal angle from top-left to bottom-right?
questions.explanation: linear-gradient(to bottom right, ...) or linear-gradient(135deg, ...) establishes a diagonal top-left to bottom-right angle.
